turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-to-ad-spend ratio metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) and Ad spend (EUR), which for 1-30 September 2026 were 12,582.75 EUR and 6,270.00 EUR.
